chapter.title: The futur simple and the futur antérieur

sections.title: Conjunctions used with the indicative mood

grammar_rules.title: Formation of the futur simple and irregular stems
grammar_rules.explanation:
For regular -er and -ir verbs, use the full infinitive. For -re verbs, drop the final 'e'.
Key irregular stems:
- avoir -> aur-
- être -> ser-
- aller -> ir-
- faire -> fer-
- venir -> viendr-
- pouvoir -> pourr-
- vouloir -> voudr-
- savoir -> saur-
- devoir -> devr-
- voir -> verr-
- envoyer -> enverr-

steps: Take infinitive or irregular future stem

notes: The future endings are derived from the present tense of avoir (-ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont).

common_mistakes.explanation: Future 1st person singular ends in -ai, conditional ends in -ais.

grammar_rules.title: The futur antérieur (future perfect)
grammar_rules.summary: Future of auxiliary (aurai/serai) + past participle. Expresses an action that will be completed before another future action.
grammar_rules.explanation: 'Quand j'aurai fini mes études, je trouverai un travail' (When I have finished my studies, I will find a job).

steps: Conjugate avoir or être in futur simple

usage_conditions: Action completed before another future event

grammar_rules.title: Use of future tenses after temporal conjunctions (quand, dès que, etc.)
grammar_rules.summary: French requires the FUTURE tense after quand, lorsque, dès que, aussitôt que, tant que when referring to future events, unlike English which uses present.
grammar_rules.explanation: In English: 'When I arrive, I will call you' (present arrive). In French: 'Quand j'arriverai, je t'appellerai' (future arriverai).
usage_conditions: Time clauses referring to the future

common_mistakes.wrong: Quand j'arrive demain, je te verrai
common_mistakes.correct: Quand j'arriverai demain, je te verrai
common_mistakes.explanation: Use future tense after quand for future time.

usage_notes: Takes indicative; requires future tense when referring to future

examples.french: Demain, je partirai pour Lyon à la première heure.
examples.english: Tomorrow, I will leave for Lyon at the earliest hour.

examples.french: Quand nous aurons terminé ce travail, nous sortirons.
examples.english: When we have finished this work, we will go out.

examples.french: Dès qu'il arrivera, nous commencerons la réunion.
examples.english: As soon as he arrives, we will start the meeting.
